projects.title: Arc & Ember
projects.description: An interior visualisation shaped by generous arches, a double-height living room and layers of timber, stone and soft upholstery. Pale, light-filled family spaces lead into an intimate formal lounge with carved timber screens, richly patterned rugs and a warm timber ceiling. A study in the balance between openness, detail and everyday comfort.

projects.title: Aurelia House
projects.description: An interior visualisation shaped by warm light, soft ivory tones and rich timber accents. Generous glazing brings daylight into the living spaces, while a fireplace forms the heart of the lounge and dining area. The kitchen, private suite and sitting rooms carry the same calm palette through layered lighting, stone textures and carefully framed views.
